fields.name: amount
docs: Liquidation fees, in collateral tokens.

fields.name: timelock_seconds
docs: Delay before queued risk changes can be applied. Fixed at init.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the token accounts protocol fees are paid to. Default = not set yet.

fields.name: pending_treasury
docs: A treasury change waiting for the timelock. Default = none.

fields.name: amount
docs: Interest fees, in lend tokens.

fields.name: collateral_seized
docs: Collateral taken from the position, including the protocol fee.

fields.name: protocol_fee
docs: Part of the seized collateral kept by the protocol.

fields.name: oracle_accounts
docs: Accounts the price is read from, in order. Unused slots are default.

fields.name: collateral_is_token0
docs: XDEX only: true when the collateral is the pool's token 0.

fields.name: cash
docs: Lend tokens held in the liquidity vault (internal count; donations are ignored).

fields.name: total_borrow_scaled
docs: Total debt in scaled units: debt = scaled * borrow_index / WAD.

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Interest owed to the protocol, in lend raw units.

fields.name: cumulative_bad_debt
docs: Debt written off after liquidations ran out of collateral (lend raw units).

fields.name: protocol_collateral_fees
docs: Liquidation fees owed to the protocol, in collateral raw units. Held in the
collateral vault on top of `total_collateral`.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Risk and rate settings for one market. All bps values are out of 10_000.

fields.name: max_ltv_bps
docs: Borrow limit: debt may not exceed this share of collateral value.

fields.name: liquidation_threshold_bps
docs: Liquidation starts when debt exceeds this share of collateral value.

fields.name: liquidation_bonus_bps
docs: Extra collateral a liquidator receives, on top of the debt repaid.

fields.name: close_factor_bps
docs: Most of a position's debt one liquidation may repay.

fields.name: reserve_factor_bps
docs: Share of interest kept as protocol fees.

fields.name: optimal_utilization_bps
docs: Utilization where the rate curve steepens.

fields.name: max_utilization_bps
docs: Borrows may not push utilization above this.

fields.name: base_rate_bps
docs: Annual rate at 0% utilization.

fields.name: slope1_bps
docs: Added annual rate from 0% to optimal utilization.

fields.name: slope2_bps
docs: Added annual rate from optimal to 100% utilization.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Max total lender assets (lend token raw units).

fields.name: borrow_cap
docs: Max total borrows (lend token raw units).

fields.name: max_borrow_per_obligation
docs: Max debt of one position (lend token raw units).

fields.name: dust_debt
docs: Positions with debt at or under this may be liquidated in full.

fields.name: twap_window_secs
docs: XDEX TWAP window in seconds (ignored for stake pool markets).

fields.name: liquidation_fee_bps
docs: Share of each liquidation bonus kept by the protocol (paid in collateral).
